traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Love and value meet intensity. All-or-nothing attraction, deep desire, and a strong pull toward control in relationships. The trine makes this a natural strength: Depth and devotion in love, used deliberately. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
